name: NOTE_RESEARCH_LINK_HX
description: This table contains information about how the research study linkage on a note has changed over time.

columns.name: NOTE_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier (.1 item) for the note record.

columns.name: LINE
columns.description: The line number for the information associated with this record. Multiple pieces of information can be associated with this record.

columns.name: HX_RESEARCH_ID_RESEARCH_STUDY_NAME
columns.description: The name of the research study record.

columns.name: HX_ENROLL_ID
columns.description: History of the linked study association for the note.

columns.name: HX_STUDY_LINK_UTC_DTTM
columns.description: History of when the research link of the note was modified.

columns.name: HX_STUDY_USER_ID
columns.description: History of the user who modified the research link of a note.

columns.name: HX_STUDY_USER_ID_NAME
columns.description: The name of the user record. This name may be hidden.
